defects.what: Spike not moved to design/spike/archived/ after its implementation landed (spike README step 5); tracker.md:33 link not updated.
toPrioritiesPageProps is an arrow const while toDumpPageProps is a function declaration; sibling adapters differ in style.
The feed parameter type is hand-written rather than derived from fetchDumpEntriesAction's return type, so it can drift.
DUMP_FEED_PAGE / DUMP_EMPTY_PAGE carry no type annotation while the priorities fixtures are typed MatrixData.
togglePopover is an inline closure in the context object while the other handlers are named; new arrow handlers sit beside function-declaration handlers.
Each MatrixTaskCard specimen gets its own PrioritiesPageContext provider inside the map instead of one shared per activePlanId.
